mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate increases borrowing costs, which may lead to decreased consumer and business spending, negatively impacting S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by 0.5% in one month
failure_condition: If S&P 500 returns are positive in 60% of cases when FEDFUNDS increases by 0.5%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in unemployment rate indicates a weakening labor market, which may lead to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 returns are positive in 60% of cases when UNRATE increases by 0.2%, the hypothesis is rejected.
